summary: Patient and professional excellence oriented Pharmacist with Doctor of Pharmacy and Master in Science degrees. Nine years of retail experience providing outstanding pharmacy services in a high-volume setting. Strong background in science and clinical pharmacology and excellent interpersonal skills with a track record of establishing positive relationships with customers, co-workers, medical professionals, and insurance providers. Enthusiastic about acquiring new clinical knowledge and experience in a hospital setting.
certifications: In good standing with the Massachusetts Board of Pharmacy

education.institution: Massachusetts College of Pharmacy and Health Science

education.degree: Master of Science in Hardware Engineering
education.institution: University of Information Technology, Mechanics and Optics

experience.title: Staff Pharmacist
responsibilities: Managed ancillary staff to fulfill over 1,500 prescriptions weekly.
Consulted with physicians and patients on medication dosage, drug interactions, and side effects.
Dispensed and compounded prescriptions, maintaining accurate patient records.
Processed written, oral, and electronic prescriptions.
Conducted drug utilization reviews and therapy management.
Maintained inventory, ordering, returns, and inter-store transfers.
Ensured compliance with state and federal record‑keeping guidelines.

experience.title: Pharmacy Intern
responsibilities: Assisted in dispensing medications and patient counseling.
Supported inventory management and record maintenance.

experience.title: Pharmacy Technician
responsibilities: Prepared and dispensed medications under pharmacist supervision.
Maintained medication records and assisted with inventory.

experience.title: Electronics Technician
responsibilities: Maintained and troubleshot electronic and computer‑based equipment.
Recorded precision measurements and completed database reports.
Supported engineering team as a customer service representative.
